Pre-release build for ${TAG}. Binaries are not code-signed. Check files against SHA256SUMS.txt. Install steps are in [docs/install.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/${TAG}/docs/install.md).

## Changes

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/${TAG}/CHANGELOG.md).

## Requirements

- Linux binaries are built on Ubuntu 22.04. The host needs glibc 2.34 or newer. The desktop client is released from [PandaQuQ/robroz-client](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client).

## Known issues

- None listed.
